summary.text: Monet Wilson is an independent write-in candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Democrat Thaddeus Jones.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an alderwoman and the first African American alderwoman in the history of Calumet City.

paragraphs.text: Monet Wilson said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a married mother of two sons and a public servant.
She said she was elected as the first African American alderwoman in the 128-year history of Calumet City.
Wilson's survey lists a platform of balancing budgets before raising taxes, reviewing the SAFE-T Act, and lowering property taxes by changing how Illinois funds public schools.
